I don't follow all the technical parts, but the important thing for me is that everything we agreed on is still here — and reading through it, it is. Pasting a link and having the title, description, and icon pulled in, opening links, the read-later view separate from favorites, my own notes, the searching with tags and quotes and the and/or/not combos, and the bulk actions with a count and confirmation before anything permanent — I can see all of that reflected.

I'm glad you're being careful about safety when the app goes out to fetch a page's details, and that my bookmarks are stored so they'll still be there next time I open it.

This plan works for me. Go ahead and break it into the tasks you'll build from.
